_comment: The single coworld-builder deployment. `agent` is filled in by fleet/bin/deploy.py from the coordinator id it created (create) or read from fleet/cloud.md (update). `environment_id` and `vault_ids` are read from fleet/cloud.md; the placeholders here are what deploy.py substitutes. `authorization_token` is NEVER stored in git — deploy.py re-supplies it from `gh auth token` at apply time, exactly as fleetctl.py does.
